case_title: INA SOFIA KALO VS. VAULT MANAGEMENT INC.

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-15-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KALO, INA SOFIA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VAULT MANAGEMENT INC. $6,474.00 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,549.00, PLAINTIFF WAS TERMINATED JULY 09, 2019. EMPLOYER DID NOT PAY WAGES UNTIL AUGUST 16, 2019. COURT AWARDS A WAITING TIME PENALTY OF 19 DAYS, $6474. COURT FINDS THAT DEFENDANTS FAILURE TO PAY WAS NOT WILLFUL UNTIL JULY 27, 2019. DEFENDANT ATTEMPTED TO PAY BY CHECK BUT THE CHECK WAS RETURNED FOR NSF AND OTHERWISE NOT PAID ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS JUSTIFYING THE COURT'S FINDING THE FAILURE TO PAY WAS NOT WILLFUL UNTIL JULY 27, 2019.
